Treatment summary
Patient presented following a low-speed head-on collision with reported headache, dizziness, and intermittent
difficulty concentrating. Over four visits, the injury was evaluated and managed conservatively. The reported
symptoms are consistent with the mechanism and force of the collision. Examination findings were partly supportive
of a concussive injury, including tenderness on palpation and mild balance disturbance on tandem gait, while other
neurological screneing tests, including cranial nerve assessment, pupillary response, and strength testing, were
within normal limits. Recovery has been somewhat slower than typically seen for this injury, and symptom
management and graded activity guidance were extended accordingly. No prior injury to the same region has been
reported in the available history. Billing records for the four encounters reflect single charges for each service, with no
duplicate or repeated billing observed. Ongoing follow-up is recommended to monitor symptom resolution and
return-to-activity progress.
</page>

"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
